marker.description: Blue-headed pin inserted into the superior surface of the corpus callosum.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the pin.
main_explanation: The pin is located in the large, C-shaped band of white matter that connects the left and right cerebral hemispheres, situated superior to the lateral ventricles.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located immediately inferior to the structure indicated by the pin?
supporting_question.explanation: The corpus callosum forms the roof of the lateral ventricles. The third ventricle is located inferior to the thalamus, which is medial to the lateral ventricles.
